meta.name: Shiro Daika
meta.crop_outlier_ok: Outside the rampart the map carries only the gate furniture, the wharf works, the towpath and the aqueduct until feature 021 fills the interior; sparse outliers at this stage are the build order showing through, not a siting error.

lines.label: packed row housing IN-WALL (laborer/servant/merchant/burakumin)
lines.basis: ~70% of 2160 families x C_PACKED 690 px^2 gross (Tango-measured rows + eaves + roji)

lines.label: packed row housing SUBURBAN (kashi wharf belt + guan-xiang gate wards)
lines.basis: ground OUTSIDE the rampart - excluded from the interior the wall must hold (021 research: Changmen / machi-chi; the drawn suburbs carry these families)

lines.label: the castle (enceinte: baileys + moats; interior implied)
lines.basis: declared 50 ha, seat=ring - Hirosaki ~50 ha to Himeji ~233 ha; the ENCEINTE, not the keep (a tenshu is ~1.2% of the works)

lines.label: samurai walled yashiki in-wall (Ranks 8-12)
lines.basis: upper rank band x C_YASHIKI 4150 px^2 gross (Fukui Suginuma plan, a 1,000-koku plot + street margin)

lines.label: samurai detached houses in-wall (Ranks 5-7)
lines.basis: middle rank band x C_SPACED 2480 px^2 gross (Tango samurai-ward measurement)

lines.label: retainer terraces in-wall (Ranks 1-4)
lines.basis: junior rank band x C_TERRACE 660 px^2 gross (Shibata ashigaru-nagaya floor, detached house ceiling) - NOT ashigaru, who are peasants in Rokugan

lines.basis: 2 precinct(s) x 2.5 adept-monk households at C_PACKED gross (clergy live outside the lay caste table)

lines.label: cargo canal + dock basin
lines.basis: one in-wall water feature at capital scale (twice the provincial figure)

lines.label: circulation (trunk + ring road + streets + alleys)
lines.basis: 20% of interior at drawn widths - MEASURED from the drawn first capital (street mesh, band lanes, alleys, compound halos), against the provincial 7%

_regression.source: Shiro Daika as it stood when the GM caught the overflow from the render (2026-08-10): 1,238 of 2,182 packed dwellings (57%) outside the walls against the researched 30% suburb share, because the wall was sized with Tango's C_PACKED (690 px2/family) while the capital's as-built machi delivers ~1,367 - and the band check validated only the packed TOTAL, so the in-wall shortfall was silently spilled into the suburbs. The split packed_inwall/packed_suburb targets were added against exactly this map; this fixture keeps the overflow geometry caught after the live map is re-laid inside its resized wall.
